desc: Derive the reduction: positions `p_j` of 1s, `b_j = p_j - j` is non-decreasing, answer = `Σ|b_j - median(b)|` (no sorting needed).
Hand-verify the formula on the three samples (3, 0, 7).
Write the complete final program (fast stdin parsing, `b` array, median at `b[k//2]`, int64-safe sum, plain integer output).
Re-check edge cases: single 1, `S="11"`, `S="10"`, all 1s, trailing newline/CR (handled by `split()`).
Confirm performance/overflow at N = 5·10⁵ worst case (numpy O(N) path, int64 casting before sum).
